item: A held store stops the page-size walk at the first busy error, and unlock says in use (row 154)
summary: An encrypted open that meets a lock (SQLite busy or locked, extended codes masked) stops its page-size walk at that candidate instead of waiting out the busy timeout and a key derivation at each of up to nine: the at-rest probe of a held store took about 2.3 s, now one busy timeout; a 30 s open fails after 30 s, not up to 270 s. Both unlock routes answer 409 'another program is using this store' (x12) for such a store instead of 'the passphrase does not open this file', and the refusal is not counted. Trade, stated in connect: a lock released after the first timeout is not waited out by the next candidate.
